user.title: Set up Virtual EMS
user.description: Describe the size of the installation you want to simulate. Everything can be changed later through Options.

data_description.naam: This name is part of every entity id, for example sensor.lokaal_a_pv_vermogen.
data_description.pv_piek_kwp: The power the array delivers at standard test conditions.
data_description.batterij_kwh: Usable storage capacity of the home battery.
data_description.laadpaal_max_kw: 11 kW matches a common three phase wall box.

error.ongeldige_naam: Enter a name that contains letters or digits.

abort.already_configured: An installation with this name already exists.

init.title: Adjust Virtual EMS
init.description: Change the installation without reinstalling. The integration reloads itself when you save.

data.dagstart_uur: Fixed start hour of the simulated day

data_description.jaarverbruik_kwh: Scales the base load. Enter the real annual consumption of the example house; the default is an order of magnitude only.
data_description.dagstart_uur: Leave empty to follow the real clock. Enter 11 to start every lesson at 11:00, even during an evening class.

set_scenario.name: Set scenario
set_scenario.description: Sets up a complete lesson situation in one go: cloud cover, battery level, charger, appliances and the time of the simulated day.

scenario.name: Scenario
scenario.description: The lesson situation you want to prepare.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Sets all cumulative kWh counters to zero and the battery back to 50 percent, so a new class starts clean.

alleen_tellers.name: Counters only
alleen_tellers.description: On: only the counters and the battery level are reset. Off: the controls return to their starting position as well.
